result.reason: Neither position is fully satisfied. The redline omits the central warranty that software and deliverables conform to documentation, provides no 12-month software period, uses a delivery-based notice trigger that does not reliably apply to all Services, and omits a repair/correction remedy. It is also non-minimal because it adds separate pharmaceutical-product requirements concerning specifications, GMP, adulteration, misbranding, latent defects and preservation of other remedies. The express-warranty carveout in the disclaimer avoids a direct contradiction, and unrelated commercial language remains operative.
